execution.note: PREDATES THE SCOPED-REFUND FIX (2026-09-01) AND IS NOT REPOINTABLE. This instance was deployed from the bytecode whose executeSwap ended `leftover = balanceOf(tokenIn); safeTransfer(msg.sender, leftover)` - the adapter's WHOLE balance. Anyone can transfer USDC to this address; the next VaultCore.executeRebalance leg through it then reverts Panic(0x11) at `spent = inBefore - inAfter` whenever the donation exceeds what the route pulled. VaultCore.isAllowedAdapter is constructor-only, so every vault created against this adapter - including the smoke vault 0x4d60e49d451117b9ab8f9fb9be56454ab7f01a0f - is permanently bound to it. The soak runs against this old shape: a rebalance failure there may be this finding rather than the soak's own subject. Redeploying means a NEW adapter AND new vaults. Mainnet must deploy the fixed bytecode.
